title: Release 0.9.0: bump, build, qualify and publish the quest-only release superseding the unpublished 0.8.0 tag
description:
Ships the frozen-but-unpublished 0.8.0 content together with the 15 post-freeze commits, under the next unclaimed number. Scope ratified by opum-agent (R5); publication itself is tier 3 and goes to the repository owner directly, never on an orchestrator say-so.

WHY 0.9.0 AND NOT 0.8.0 OR 0.8.1. The v0.8.0 tag exists at 9d91fc35 and will not be re-pointed: quest-web runs a live link gate against this repository, and opum-marketplace re-resolves tag to commit to tree against a recorded baseline, so a moved tag falsifies every record citing it. The precedent for a tagged-but-unpublished version is 0.6.1 to 0.6.2 -- ship under the next unclaimed number. Relative to PUBLISHED 0.7.1 this carries a breaking change plus a feature, so the next unclaimed number is a minor one.

PAIR STATE. Not a lockstep release. lore-cli dev is 64 commits past their v0.7.0 and they intend 0.8.0, but they are gated on LCLI-533 and on qualification ordering. OPAG-142 already qualified lore 0.7.0 with quest 0.7.1 as a non-lockstep pair, so the pair does not mean equal strings. The CHANGELOG declares the break, as the convention requires.

KNOWN HAZARD IN THIS SEQUENCE. Building rewrites npm/quest-darwin-arm64/bin/quest, and on this host an executed freshly-built darwin-arm64 binary makes any git read of that path SIGKILL (exit 137, QCLI-271). The runbook ordering is mandatory: do every execution first, then delete and recreate the file from an untouched copy of the build artifact as the literal last step before git touches it, with zero execution in between.

ALSO IN FLIGHT, NOT BLOCKING. opum-cli-e2e needs two artifacts from the qualification run to bind their pair qualification: the candidate bundle and the native-execution receipt. They need the run id and the tag, and have asked for a SHA quoted as v0.9.0^{commit} rather than git rev-parse v0.9.0, which returns the tag object for an annotated tag.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every hand-edited version site named in the release runbook carries 0.9.0, verified by re-reading each file rather than by trusting the runbook list -- package.json version and its six optionalDependencies pins, src/application/version.ts, src/contract/tracker/index.ts, fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json, and .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
bun.lock platform pins are regenerated rather than left at the previous version, since nothing automates this and a stale lockfile breaks the frozen-lockfile install in CI.
All six platform packages are rebuilt and their checksum map matches, with bun run check and bun run test:packages both exiting 0.
CHANGELOG Unreleased is renamed to 0.9.0 at tag time AND a fresh empty Unreleased heading is left above it -- the omission of the successor is what produced QCLI-319.
dev is promoted to main by fast-forward after the required contexts go green on that exact SHA, and the promoted ref is asserted by reading it back from the API rather than from the push exit code.
The v0.9.0 tag is created and the v0.8.0 tag is left pointing at 9d91fc35.

Publication is performed only under explicit authorization from the repository owner, obtained immediately before it, and the registry state is re-checked afterward rather than inferred from the publish exit code.

implementationNotes:
PROGRESS as of the byte commit, branch chore/QCLI-347-release-0.9.0, two commits landed on the branch and not yet merged.

STRINGS (5347d5d). All six hand-edited sites moved to 0.9.0 and each re-read after the edit rather than trusted from the runbook list: package.json .version plus its six optionalDependencies pins, src/application/version.ts QUEST_VERSION, src/contract/tracker/index.ts QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json questVersion, .claude-plugin/plugin.json .version. A grep for 0.8.0 across src, fixtures, .claude-plugin and package.json returns nothing afterward, so this bump had no undiscovered sixth site -- the runbook list was accurate for this release, which is worth recording because it has drifted before. bun.lock regenerated under bun 1.3.14 (matching packageManager) so its platform pins move with the bump and configVersion survives.

BYTES (4b60e7a). All six platforms rebuilt, including bun-windows-aarch64 which needs 1.3.x. CLAUDE.md managed block regenerated to 0.9.0 by running agents --update-instructions against the FRESHLY BUILT darwin-arm64 binary, not the global install: it reported version-only before and current after.

QCLI-271 SIGKILL: handled by the runbook ordering, and the hazard was OBSERVED rather than merely avoided. Pristine copy of the darwin-arm64 binary taken before any execution; all executions done (--version reporting 0.9.0, agents --check, agents --update-instructions); git status then exited 137 exactly as predicted; delete-and-recreate from the pristine copy cleared it (old inode 37849830, new 37850022, sha256 identical at 0dbf171e...). So it is a new inode, not new bytes.

GREEN ON THE BRANCH: bun run check exit 0 at 592 pass / 0 fail; check:packages exit 0; test:packages exit 0. git status clean after those executions, which confirms the CLAUDE.md re-measurement that a CLEAN index does not re-arm the kill.

REMAINING: open the PR, merge to dev, promote dev to main by fast-forward, rename CHANGELOG Unreleased to 0.9.0 AND leave a fresh empty Unreleased above it (QCLI-319), tag v0.9.0, dispatch the qualification workflow against the tag, then seek the owner authorization that publication requires. Nothing is published and nothing is tagged yet.
